## About

SUDRA is the brand of the partnership between SudreScodeS and Dtech Labs.
We build practical digital products for Brazilian businesses: clear scope,
realistic timelines, and negotiable investment based on needs.

A SUDRA é a marca da sociedade entre SudreScodeS e Dtech Labs.
Unimos produto, engenharia e entrega prática para o dia a dia do negócio.

## Services

- Websites / landings / institutional sites (simple to feature-rich)
- Order & sales systems (menu, cart, checkout, payments, order panel)
- ERP / CRM (sales, inventory, finance, customers, reports, analytics)
- Scheduling systems (clinics, salons, consultancies)
- Custom software (dashboards, AI workflows, business-specific flows)

## Reference pricing (BRL; USD shown on English locale)

Ranges are starting references; final price depends on scope.
Sites: setup payable in up to 4 installments.
Systems: ongoing monthly fee + setup also payable in up to 4 installments.
Table prices do not include hosting, database, or maintenance (billed separately).

- Landing / simple site: R$ 600–1.000 setup · up to 4x
- Institutional site: R$ 1.000–2.000 setup · up to 4x
- Full institutional site: R$ 2.000–2.500 setup · up to 4x
- Site with custom features: R$ 2.500–5.000 setup · up to 4x
- Scheduling system: R$ 2.000–5.000 setup · R$ 50–200/month
- Orders / sales system: R$ 3.000–8.000 setup · R$ 400/month
- ERP / CRM: R$ 5.000–15.000 setup · R$ 800/month
- Highly custom system: quote on demand
